ollama.name: Ollama (Local)
ollama.description: Locally-run open-source model service; no network or Key needed, data stays fully local.
tips: Install and start Ollama: ollama serve
Download a model: ollama pull llama3.3

Enter a locally downloaded model name

custom-openai.name: Custom OpenAI-compatible

tips: Fill in the endpoint (including /v1)
Fill in the API Key as required upstream (blank for local proxies)
Enter a model identifier supported upstream

custom-anthropic.name: Custom Anthropic-compatible
tips: Fill in the endpoint base (e.g. https://host/anthropic/v1)
Fill in the API Key
Enter an upstream model identifier

ollama.name: Ollama (Local)
ollama.description: Locally-run embedding models; data is processed entirely on-device, no network needed, best privacy.
models: Lightweight: fast with low resource usage
tips: Install Ollama first: visit https://ollama.com/download
Pull a model: ollama pull nomic-embed-text
Start the service: ollama serve
Leave the API Key blank or enter any characters
Enter a downloaded model name, e.g. nomic-embed-text

lmstudio.name: LM Studio (Local)
lmstudio.description: A GUI local model manager that can load any Sentence-BERT model; suited for advanced users.
models: Light and fast, suits most scenarios
tips: Download and install LM Studio: https://lmstudio.ai
Search and download an embedding model in the app
Start the local server (Local Server tab)
Default port is 1234, changeable in settings
Supports any HuggingFace-format embedding model

siliconflow.name: SiliconFlow (Recommended)
siliconflow.description: Offers many open-source embedding models (bge-m3, Qwen Embedding, etc.), fully OpenAI-API-compatible, great value.
models: ⭐ Strongly recommended: multilingual, supports 8192-token long text
Pro version: higher quality, for production
Ultra-long context: supports 32768 tokens, for long documents
Balanced choice: trade-off of performance and quality
tips: Free credits on signup, beginner-friendly
Fully OpenAI-API-compatible, easy to integrate
Recommended bge-m3 model, excellent and cost-effective
Supports BAAI, Alibaba Qwen and more model series
Fast and stable access within China

bailian.name: Alibaba Bailian (Recommended)
bailian.description: From Alibaba Cloud; text-embedding-v3 performs excellently, supports dynamic dimension adjustment, enterprise-grade stability.
models: ⭐ Latest: best quality, supports dynamic dimension adjustment
tips: Requires an Alibaba Cloud account with Bailian enabled
Supports the dimensions parameter for custom output (768/1024/1536)
text-embedding-v3 is among the best Chinese models today
Alibaba Cloud enterprise-grade stability
Supports encoding_format: float or base64

volcano.name: BytePlus Volcano Ark
volcano.description: From ByteDance; Doubao embedding models served via the Volcano Ark platform.
models: Doubao embedding: ByteDance in-house, stable quality
Large version: higher dimensions, better expressiveness
tips: Create an inference endpoint on the Volcano Ark platform
The model name is the endpoint ID (e.g. ep-20240101-xxxxxx)
After creating an endpoint in the console, copy its ID as the model name
Supports ByteDance's Doubao model series
Suited for users already on Volcano Cloud

openai-compatible.name: OpenAI / OpenAI-compatible
openai-compatible.description: Official OpenAI embedding API, the industry benchmark; also usable for other OpenAI-compatible services.
models: ⭐ Value: fast and affordable, recommended for most scenarios
tips: Requires an international credit card
Get the API Key on the OpenAI platform
A proxy may be required in some regions
Supports the dimensions parameter to reduce vector size
text-embedding-3-small has the best value
